public_holidays: Moselle, Bas-Rhin and Haut-Rhin only (Alsace-Moselle local law): 26 December (second day of Christmas) and Good Friday are additional public holidays; Good Friday is a statutory holiday only in communes with a Protestant or mixed church.

laws.rule: In the core of Parc national de forêts, a one-night bivouac is allowed near roads and paths from one hour before sunset to one hour after sunrise; the national parks portal says wild camping is prohibited. Check the precise location and current park rules.
